# VHGLOBALS Video Division

> Premium video editing retainers with a dedicated senior editor and quality
> checker. Specialising in real estate, SaaS explainer, documentary, talking
> head and GeoLayers 3 map animation. Short-form drafts in 24 to 48 hours.

VHGLOBALS provides monthly video editing retainers rather than per-video
pricing. Each client is assigned a dedicated lead editor who stays on the
account, plus a quality checker who reviews every delivery against a 27-point
checklist. The model is built for clients publishing on a consistent cadence
who need the same editor learning their style, rather than re-briefing a new
freelancer each time.

Turnaround: short-form drafts in 24 to 48 hours, with QC review.
Communication: shared Slack or Discord channel with the creative director.
Contact: vhstudios.global@gmail.com
Booking: https://calendly.com/vhstudios-global/30min

## Services

- Real estate video editing: Luxury property walkthroughs, drone footage speed ramping and stabilisation, architectural motion tracking, seamless doorway match-cuts and whip transitions, window pull and HDR balancing, twilight atmospheric enhancement, 3D address and feature callouts, floor plan motion graphics, agent intro and outro branding, MLS-optimised vertical cutdowns, 4K master tours. For media production companies, luxury brokerages and top-producing agents.
- SaaS explainer and product launch video editing: Fluid cursor auto-tracking with click micro-interactions, 3D isometric device mockups and window framing, dynamic zoom-ins on high-impact value moments, typography highlighting product ROI, clean UI screen-recording stabilisation and cursor smoothing, animated feature breakdown callouts, professional audio mixing and pacing optimisation. For B2B tech founders, product marketers and venture-backed SaaS startups.
- Documentary video editing: 2.5D camera parallax on archival photography, custom paper rip and vintage film overlays, multi-source document redaction and highlight animations, cinematic archival photo grading and grain overlays, immersive sound design and ambient tension layers, investigative lower-third text styling, map trace animations. For investigative YouTubers, narrative creators and modern media channels.
- Talking head video editing: Word-by-word animated subtitle typography, multi-focal punch-in zooms on key thematic words, pattern-interrupt B-roll graphics and context icons, dead-air truncation and conversational rhythm polish, smart jump-cut smoothing, sound effect accents, colour grading tuned for creator studio lighting and skin tones. For executive leaders, personal brand creators, coaches and podcast hosts.
- GeoLayers 3 map animation: Real-world DEM terrain elevation and topography modelling, smooth orbital satellite rotations and altitude plunges, country boundary extrusions and tactical vector markers, dynamic point-to-point flight path animations with curved arcs, custom location pin drops with glowing radar rings, real-time camera speed ramping across long-distance transitions, integration with custom UI overlays and screen recordings. Built in After Effects with the GeoLayers 3 plugin. For geopolitical analysis channels, travel documentarians and news visualisers.
- Hybrid multi-format retainer: A combined team for vertical shorts, YouTube master cutdowns and specialised map animations, with a dedicated lead editor plus a motion graphics specialist, guaranteed 24 to 48 hour turnaround on priority short-form, and flexible monthly volume rollover. For rapid-growth agencies and high-output creators.

## How the workflow runs

1. Dedicated editor assignment. One hand-picked editor stays on the account, learning the brand's pacing style and visual identity. Direct Slack and Discord integration, custom style guide adaptation, rapid revision tracking, no freelance onboarding overhead.
2. Ongoing skill development. Editors attend structured weekly workshops covering new visual plugins, audience psychology, 3D camera tracking, dynamic typography and short-form hook optimisation.
3. Final polish inspection. Every video is audited by an experienced supervisor against a 27-point checklist covering pacing dead zones, visual rhythm, multi-platform aspect ratio framing, and colour and skin-tone consistency.
4. Scaling. Elastic team sizing, backup editor redundancy on standby, and batch release capacity for aggressive publishing schedules.
